topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: I can’t believe this. After everything we've shared, all the trust I placed in them, they've been writing a novel about me behind my back. Every detail, every conversation, possibly twisted and splashed across pages for strangers to read. They talk about being an artist, needing to express themselves, but this? This is a violation. How could they not see the harm in that? I trusted them with my story, and they just took it, repackaged it for their own gain. We need to talk about this, but right now, I don’t know if I can even look at them without feeling...disappointed.
